strongest_angle: Explore the multi-country study published in the Journal of Consumer Research in 2026, featuring researchers from Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health, which validates mental accounting theory across 21 countries.

key_facts.fact: Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health highlighted a study published in the Journal of Consumer Research titled The Robustness of Mental Accounting Across 21 Countries.
The international study testing mental accounting effects across 21 countries was published in the Journal of Consumer Research on July 10, 2026.
The concept of mental accounting was first introduced four decades ago to explain how people mentally organize, evaluate, and track financial activities.
